classes.name: Geom2dToIGES_Geom2dCurve
classes.summary:
This class implements the transfer of the Curve Entity from Geom2d To IGES. These can be: Curve . BoundedCurve.
- BSplineCurve
- BezierCurve
- TrimmedCurve . Conic
- Circle
- Ellipse
- Hyperbloa
- Line
- Parabola . OffsetCurve

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Creates a tool Geom2dCurve ready to run and sets its fields as G2dE's.

instanceMethods.name: Transfer2dCurve
instanceMethods.signature: (start: Geom2d_Curve, Udeb: number, Ufin: number): IGESData_IGESEntity
instanceMethods.comment: Transfer an Entity from Geom2d to IGES. If this Entity could not be converted, this member returns a NullEntity.

classes.name: Geom2dToIGES_Geom2dEntity
classes.summary: provides methods to transfer Geom2d entity from CASCADE to IGES.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Creates a tool ready to run and sets its fields as GE's.

instanceMethods.name: SetUnit
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the value of the UnitFlag.

instanceMethods.name: GetUnit
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the value of the UnitFlag of the header of the model in millimeters.

classes.name: Geom2dToIGES_Geom2dPoint
classes.summary:
This class implements the transfer of the Point Entity from Geom2d to IGES. These are: . 2dPoint.
- 2dCartesianPoint

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Creates a tool Geom2dPoint ready to run and sets its fields as G2dE's.

instanceMethods.name: Transfer2dPoint
instanceMethods.comment: Transfer a Point from Geom to IGES. If this Entity could not be converted, this member returns a NullEntity.

instanceMethods.name: Transfer2dPoint
instanceMethods.comment: Transfer a CartesianPoint from Geom to IGES. If this Entity could not be converted, this member returns a NullEntity.

classes.name: Geom2dToIGES_Geom2dVector
classes.summary:
This class implements the transfer of the Vector from Geom2d to IGES. These can be: . Vector.
- Direction
- VectorWithMagnitude

constructors.name: constructor

instanceMethods.name: Transfer2dVector
